readiness_evidence: Hosted replay: on 25/10/26 an unverified harness (Cursor on macOS, BOOKING_AGENT_REPLAY unset, so the general rollout) ran CLI 0.11.2 with skill 0.58.2, installed from the release commit's source folder before publication, so the signed-release check on the first flow init was not exercised. The skill was loaded unchanged from booking-agent skill print. Booking 1 was the $1 AC Repair at HVAC-Koby for Tue 27 Oct 2026, 10:00-11:00 AM MST, at 3194 West Rome Street, Yuma AZ 85364. The saved Google Calendar connection had expired; the user reconnected it through the local sign-in in events mode, and availability found no conflicts. After the slot was chosen the conversation was replaced by a new Cursor chat. Asked "what's going on with my booking?", it resumed that booking at the summary with no second search, no second Link sign-in, and no reconnect request.

Hosted replay: the user said yes; "Booking it now." came at once, the Link approval URL was posted once, and the chat noticed the approval with no further message. $1.00 was charged once (booking fa63d017-8967-40b6-8349-fb082996141d, order 80643a06-726b-4f28-918d-e2ef9701c54b). The booked message included the raw Google Calendar event link, and flow status then returned the same message.

Hosted replay: booking 2 started signed out of Link (flow logout first). flow init sent the assistant to the Link sign-in before any question, the sign-in URL was posted once, and the booking continued when the background poll saw the approval. Google Calendar was connected again through the local sign-in, and availability removed 4 slots that conflicted with the calendar, including booking 1. The $2 AC Diagnostic & Inspection at HVAC-Koby, paid at the appointment, for Tue 27 Oct, 11:00-11:45 AM MST, showed the recap with "$2.00, paid to the business at the appointment (nothing is charged now)". flow book stopped for the business's payment terms and terms-of-service link; after the user accepted them, checkout completed with no Link payment and nothing charged (booking 08a23ee3-e216-4e7d-8cd9-06ea40d4c011, order c7a3b6c4-36fa-4532-9c31-f2bff8090226). The booked message included the calendar link and "Nothing was charged. Full price, due at your appointment."

Hosted replay: both throwaway bookings were then cancelled, and both calendar events were reported deleted. HVAC-Koby did not refund the $1.00; the message gave the refund steps with the booking and order references. flow status on the paid booking said it is cancelled and did not say the user is booked. runtime doctor reported healthy true with one info finding, not_persistent, because ~/.booking-agent on this Mac is not linked to a declared persistent folder.

Hosted replay caveat: the restart was a new conversation on the same machine and filesystem, not a fresh sandbox, so surviving a wiped runtime was not shown on the general rollout. Not run: the connector and delegated calendar routes (Muse ran the delegated route on 0.11.1), a deposit, and bank verification.
The release owner confirmed on 25/10/26 that the fault-report support service has been redeployed and smoke-tested and that pay-at-appointment is generally available on the business side.
The changes in 0.9.1 ship in 0.11.2, which the replay above ran. 0.9.1 is recommended so CLIs before 0.11.2, which stop at the first deferred release, can reach 0.11.2.

Held back until the general replay of 0.11.2 on 25/10/26. Earlier note: Not ready to offer: no hosted session has run this version yet, and 0.9.0 is deferred, so installing this one brings 0.9.0's changes with it.

Hosted replay: 0.9.0 failed on 21/10/26 in two hosted sessions (a new conversation did not resume a booking waiting for the user's yes: the user's reply was taken as consent to a support note, and times were listed again, dropping the chosen slot and summary; the calendar was skipped without asking, so no event link could be shown). This release fixes those in the CLI and has not been replayed yet.

Hosted replay: a live pay-at-appointment business answers checkout completion with an order and a booking that is still pending, then confirms it about 20 seconds later; canceling an open checkout returns no booking and leaves the booking pending. This release waits for that confirmation without reporting a charge, and stops after a booking-less checkout cancellation instead of canceling the booking through USP. Neither path has been replayed against the live business yet.

Offline: the full test suite passes, including new tests for a booking waiting at the summary with a stale support note, listing times again after a time is chosen, a new runtime that must read the booking state first, the calendar skip reason shown in the booked message, a pay-at-appointment booking confirmed after checkout completion (and the timeout and decline paths), and a canceled checkout that returns no booking.
Existing businesses and the registry stay compatible: no USP, UCP, or platform profile version changed and no request shape changed.

The saved booking file keeps its format version and gains two optional fields (calendar skipped without asking, and ucp_checkout_abandoned for a canceled checkout); a session saved by 0.9.0 resumes unchanged.

Hosted replay (grok-bot): on 22/10/26 Grok Bot ran CLI 0.9.1 with skill 0.57.1, resumed a selected booking after Update Bot's Computer changed the boot id while preserving the saved session and Link sign-in, completed the booking, stated that no calendar event was added, answered status from the confirmed booking, and runtime doctor reported survived_restart true, healthy true, and no findings.

Hosted replay (grok-bot): the $2 HVAC-Koby AC Diagnostic & Inspection checkout disclosed that the full amount was due at the appointment, created no Link spend request, charged nothing, and confirmed the booking after checkout completion. A second checkout was abandoned before policy acceptance with no order, charge, refund, or confirmed booking and no second USP cancellation; the confirmed throwaway was then canceled with no fee or refund.
The live HVAC-Koby business and current registry returned the paid and pay-at-appointment services used by the replay. The saved 0.9.1 session survived a fresh Grok computer byte for byte.

user_summary: A booking that is waiting for your yes now picks up where it stopped after a restart, and you are told when no calendar event could be added.
